description.value: A 24/7 Subway franchise in a Richmond strip mall offering the chain's standard lineup of Footlongs, 6" sandwiches, wraps, and salads. The location accepts major credit cards and offers curbside pickup and delivery in addition to dine-in. As an independently owned and operated franchise open around the clock, it is one of the few food stops in the area accessible at any hour.
